bugs.summary: Ctrl-D does not exit R console on Windows
bugs.creator: Thomas.SOEIRO

comments.text:
Ctrl-D does not exit the R console on Windows. It returns:

```
>
+
```

It worked in R 4.4.0 and it works on Linux.

Perhaps it is related to bug 18982?
comments.creator: Thomas.SOEIRO

comments.text: I tried to reproduce this on Win 11 with R 4.6.1 both in PowerShell and Git Bash and got the same behavior as explained in the first comment.

comments.text:
In response to comment 2: (probably no longer necesssary with Ivan analysis; thanks Ivan!)

I can reproduce in:

- Rterm.exe
- R.exe executed in cmd.exe
- R.exe executed in PowerShell
- R.exe executed in mintty.exe from Cygwin (or RTools according to comment 3)

"Ctrl-*" commands do not work in RGui.exe. I guess this is expected, since Ctrl-C is used for copying there.
